archive.scope: Архив эксперимента. Ревизии и сценарии указаны в отчёте.

frozen.retention_rule: Keep only a fixed rule that lowers word errors on fresh OpenSTT/mTEDx vs current; no increased deletions, number/negation errors, noise words, or Golos regression. If none improves, commit experiment only. No policy changes after this freeze.
frozen.gaps_note: 40 focused raw crops tested on tune; no admissible word insertion under strict or relaxed confidence. Strict selected on tie.

plan.control_protocol: Independent manifest is prepared by QA chat. Its bytes/hash must be frozen before candidate inference. No parameter changes after final control. Old OpenSTT holdout and Golos are regression data already decoded in previous work, not new independent evidence.

tuning_profiles_before_policy_scoring.other_guards: unchanged; no thresholds fit on control

gap_crops_tuning_stage.reason: No common eligible internal insertion in full-utterance raw hypotheses on tune; test focused context before opening final control.

decision: В приложение не перенесено: выбор аудио даёт 177→175 ошибок при +82% стоимости опыта и дополнительной замене; согласованные вставки не дали выигрыша. Нужна проверка устойчивости малого эффекта и его цены, а также реальные дальние записи.
